text:
alex: Heads up — hitting a weird SSL cert chain fail on Windows with the Python async client. Repro steps:
alex: Python 3.8 virtualenv, pip install redwood-sdk[async]
alex: call AsyncClient.chat.create(...) and it hangs during auth retry after initial TLS handshake error
maria: :eyes: can you paste the stack / error?
alex: error shows "SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED" then our retry loop tries again and the async task never finishes
alex: minimal repro attached (inline):
alex: ```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key="x", base_url="...")
await client.chat.create(model="gpt-test", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
```
samir: we had a similar report — windows CA store vs certifi precedence is funky
samir: does setting SSL_CERT_FILE=/path/to/cacert.pem help? (certifi.where())
alex: setting SSL_CERT_FILE to certifi.where() fixes it for me, but that's a bad onboarding UX on Windows
jen: workaround noted. Could be two issues: 1) requests-backed sync code uses certifi, 2) aiohttp/sslcontext on Windows doesn't pick up the env
jen: filing an issue for automated detection of cert store fallbacks and doc update :point_down:
jen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/512
alex: also noticed typing for AsyncClient has no overloads for sync/async auth hooks — IDEs complain
maria: so feature requests: better docs for Windows, env var hints in quickstart, and AsyncClient typing improvements
samir: for retries: we should avoid infinite pending state on repeated SSL handshake failures — add a fast fail after N auth errors
ops-bot: deploy note: added to eng-ml backlog, priority P2
maria: can we add a small test matrix (3.8,3.9,3.10,3.11,3.12) on Windows runners? this would prevent regressions
samir: agree. I'll add GH Action matrix and a small reproducible e2e that toggles SSL_CERT_FILE
alex: thanks — for now I'll add a short note to the Windows quickstart and link the issue
alex: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
